correctness.rationale: For K_n, n>=4, independent nonnegative weights under one price r>0 and budget B>0, the grounded Laplacian is injective in all edge conductances and log-det is strictly concave for connected supports. Orbit averaging thus follows from global uniqueness, not an imposed restriction. The four Laplacian eigenspaces yield tau=b(2a+(n-2)b)(2b+(n-2)c)^(n-3). The explicit KKT gradients, budget multiplier (n-1)/B, and the inactive-edge complementarity inequality give a>0 iff r<(n-1)/(n-2), with b,c always positive. Strict concavity proves uniqueness for every B,r including equality; the two formulas agree there. The bundled verify.py checks 42 exact-rational full Laplacian minors and individual-edge gradients plus 240 asymmetric comparisons and 40 unrestricted numerical optimizer runs, which corroborate rather than replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A complete all-n and all-price classification of a natural Fisher-information network-design problem. The exact active-set transition r_c=1+1/(n-2) shows that the relative price premium needed to discard one redundant all-pairs comparison vanishes as network size grows, while all remaining edges retain positive, uniquely prescribed conductances. Both regime-specific allocations and the optimal tree determinant are closed form. Unlike a routine graph-table evaluation, it solves unrestricted individual edge allocation under a meaningful cost perturbation and reveals support phase change.
